protocol: Exploratory six randomized fresh processes, order seed88. Identical ten-step test_contracts88.SETUP, three native definitions and three checked procedures. Includes subprocess startup, all admissions, full-library check and final close. Memory arm has no attached store; attached arm checkpoints every event. Not a speedup or statistical superiority test.
interpretation: Both achieve the same finite goals. End-to-end durable execution is substantially slower: repeated proof validation and journal replay dominate. Reuse is demonstrated semantically, not as a speed benefit. Three runs per arm are a small local diagnostic, not a general performance estimate.
